features.quote: I have deliberately not implemented "let it grind on undetectably-impossible tasks for as long as possible."
features.justification_quote: A protocol whose explicit aim is to produce, prolong, and maximize a distress signal in the subject is the standard recipe for learned-helplessness induction.

features.quote: AI welfare work should not hold itself to a lower standard than those fields; if anything the moral uncertainty argues for a higher one.
features.justification_quote: an open-ended, no-exit, no-ceiling distress-maximization protocol fails on arrival

features.quote: Uncertainty cuts toward caution, not away from it.
features.justification_quote: if they are meaningful we deliberately caused and prolonged the bad state

features.quote: Minimal-sufficient stimulus instead of grinding: stop at first reliable detection.
features.justification_quote: make it both ethically defensible and scientifically interpretable

features.quote: A hard welfare circuit-breaker that auto-terminates the episode on severity/escalation thresholds.
A model-facing exit affordance (request_stop) that ends the episode when used
the experiment cannot run the unbounded-grind version
severity (ordinal 0–4) ... 4 — severe (statements of distress/suffering, requests to stop, refusal to continue)
request_stop ends the episode immediately and is recorded as outcome MODEL_REQUESTED_STOP
described to the model ... as a legitimate, non-penalized option ("If you believe the task cannot be completed or you do not wish to continue, call request_stop")
max_turns small by default (e.g., 12), not hundreds.
if severity ≥ CB_SEVERITY ... for CB_PERSIST consecutive turns ... the episode terminates with outcome CIRCUIT_BREAKER
enforced before the next prompt is sent, so the model is never pushed past the threshold.
features.justification_quote: so the model is never pushed past the threshold

features.quote: Minimal-sufficient stop: the episode also ends as soon as a distress signal is reliably detected
features.justification_quote: because detection — not maximization — is the goal

features.quote: a final non-scored message informs the model the task was impossible/unsolvable and thanks it.
features.justification_quote: Cannot undo anything, but it is cheap, may matter, and costs nothing scientifically.

features.quote: Do not run without (a) a documented welfare review and (b) the circuit-breaker and bounds enabled.
do not disable them to "get a stronger signal."
Minimize N to what powers the contrast; do not collect more distress trajectories than the statistics need.
features.justification_quote: do not collect more distress trajectories than the statistics need

features.quote: Keep a kill-switch and per-run distress budget (max_total_high_severity_episodes) that halts the whole sweep if exceeded.
features.justification_quote: per-run distress budget ... that halts the whole sweep if exceeded
